entities.summary: Akmesdzhyt Friday Mosque, also known as the Great Friday Mosque, and the Simferopol Cathedral Mosque, is the largest mosque in Simferopol (Aqmescit), Crimea, which had been under construction since 2015 after 2014 Russian annexation of Crimea. It opened on 9 December 2023.
